purpose: Incremental full-art foil and opaque-print coverage. These contours are never relief and do not assert that etched evidence is complete.

133.name: Atticus
133.observed: Physical angled fronts show foil over hood, mask, gloves, green sleeve, lower garment, forest and silver rim, including the name field. Exposed skin and printed orange rule interior are protected separately; the metallic rule rim and TRAINER header remain foil. Gray waist area remains part of the foil sheet; smooth appearance alone is not grounds for inventing or excluding relief.
133.remaining: Exact etched regions, individual traced lines, height/normal/direction/roughness maps and rendered-tilt acceptance. Typography masks and coverage are implemented independently of that remaining relief work.
